milestone: N3-B local exact-commit Git snapshot API foundation
implementation: Import canonical local worktree/bare Git repositories by full SHA-1 commit; copy bounded object storage into private database without source config/refs/hooks
Use fixed system Git with explicit environment, no shell/protocol/lazy-fetch/pager/hooks/fsmonitor, bounded pipe capture and per-command timeout
Strict object validation and raw tree/blob materialization reject symlinks/gitlinks/unsafe paths/filesystem aliases; strip executable modes and validate library metadata
SHA-256 source-tree integrity and exact metadata schema; offline loading never invokes Git or accesses origin repository
Exclusive Darwin directory publication, verified concurrent winner, normal failure cleanup and no overwrite/repair of existing snapshots

coverage: Loose and packed bare stores, commit/repository identity and raw blob/export attributes behavior
Unsafe source Git config and inherited config environment do not execute marker commands
Invalid/missing/noncommit revisions, symlink/gitlink trees, invalid manifests, object corruption, alternates and directory spelling collisions reject without changing published cache entries
Object/file/source/listing budgets and nonzero timeout validation; failed staging is removed
Source/metadata tampering, extra files and empty directories, symlinks and corrupt-cache reinstall rejection
Concurrent process publication converges on one digest; offline load succeeds after origin repository is renamed away
Snapshot-backed manifest graph preserves two nominal versions and transitive worker calls; generated functions instrumented for ASan/TSan
limitations: No actual timeout expiry or hard child-memory exhaustion injection
No public installer command, dependency declarations, complete graph activation, lockfile or remote transport
No managed CLI/editor/Metal integration or installed-package qualification
No full native suite; existing scoped graph and library metadata regressions are included
